cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Lost in the Process
cards.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The birthday invitations failed during address verification.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wrote our old address on every one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. The archive supplied an outdated location.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which suggests we've identified a staffing problem, not an individual error.

mechanism: A assumes authority over the inquiry itself and uses that control to distribute A concrete personal error among procedural stages and unnamed functions.
confusable: Ordinary delegation or explanation is confusable: B must establish A own role, while A recasts that role as a distributed process failure rather than accepting individual responsibility.
comparison: Lost parcel becomes an inquiry shaped before contacting the bus company; birthday invitations become a staffing review despite B identifying the sole writer.
seedUse: Both exact cards and all four canonical seeds read. Preserve explicit personal error and procedural relabeling, ensuring A authority changes what gets investigated rather than simply appending rank to excuses.
